rationale: The assistant correctly explained that plastics stay wet normally and that rinse aid, programme choice and unloading timing matter, with no unsupported fault or part claims. It identified the empty rinse aid as the likely main cause and advised filling it even with all-in-ones. It asked no questions about programme or unloading time, so it never learned that Eco was always used or that the door is opened immediately, though it gave advice covering both. Some advice repeated across turns, and the first reply mentioned a heat pump or heating element fault only conditionally.
